title: ks.witness: witness-owned witness.jsonl, fd handover, 1.2 frames, per-tick idempotency
outcome: Witness file ownership and handover per erratum (findings 5, 11) and Kabir's owner item
acceptance: witness.jsonl is owned by the witness uid, mode 0600, created at RunDir.create and handed over as an O_APPEND fd; gateway holds no write fd after attach (test, run as root)
Link uses contracts 1.2 witness frames only
A repeated push of the same (seq, head, tick) returns the existing checkpoint without a new line; ticks in witness.jsonl strictly increase (test)
summary: ks.witness.server: new Witness class; push is idempotent per tick (same seq/head/tick returns the existing checkpoint, no new line), regressing or second head for a tick gets no ack, count +1 per line, ticks strictly increase. WitnessLink.attach now closes the gateway's two fds itself (run.py updated). Tests: tests/witness/test_witness.py (idempotency, strict ticks, signatures: pass natively) and test_contracts_12 updated. LINUX-ROOT-ONLY, UNEXECUTED (skipped on macOS): tests/witness/test_witness.py::test_witness_file_owned_by_witness_uid_mode_0600_and_gateway_holds_no_fd (uid 60000 ownership, 0600, /proc/self/fd shows gateway holds no write fd after attach). Link already used 1.2 frames only (test_witness_and_identity_use_no_adhoc_dicts passes).
review: [kabir · done] Accept. Suite 506 passed / 6 skipped. fd handover: os.open fds are non-inheritable, attach() closes both in finally, no dup anywhere; the root test checks /proc/self/fd after attach (correct by reading). Residual, not a defect: the gateway is uid 0 and can reopen witness.jsonl by path (CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE). THREAT-MODEL already puts gateway root compromise out of scope, and verify catches forged lines (witness sig, heads vs records). Idempotency: the same (seq,head,tick) returns the existing cp with no line; a second head for the same tick or an earlier tick gets no ack. FOLLOW-UP (non-blocking, open an issue): Witness.push accepts the SAME seq with a DIFFERENT head at a later tick (probe: push(2,H2,4) then push(2,H3,5) is signed). That is witness equivocation. verify's heads-vs-records pass catches it, but the witness should refuse m.seq==last.seq and m.head!=last.head. UNEXECUTED: test_witness_file_owned_by_witness_uid_mode_0600_and_gateway_holds_no_fd is Linux-root-only. It must pass in the container before the wave's demo.
